Hi Ellen — welcome, and thanks for the W-9. Ive outlined the quickest path below to get Stellarnet enrolled and able to invoice us cleanly.

1) Complete Redwood AP onboarding packet (attached: redwood_ap_onboarding_packet_v2.pdf). The packet contains: legal entity, remit-to, banking preference, tax ID, and a sample invoice.
2) Upload tax forms via the secure enrollment link (we do not accept W-9 via email for production): https://app.redwoodinference.com/vendors/enroll?token=abc123.
3) Sign the vendor agreement via DocuSign (link in the packet / we can re-send).
4) Once the vendor record is active we will provide a Redwood PO number for test. Invoices must include our PO number in the invoice header (PO: #######) to auto-match. Line-level matching is helpful but not required for standard services; total + PO is our primary matcher.

Remit and invoice guidance (short):
- Remit To: Redwood Inference LLC
- Invoice must include: invoice number, invoice date, PO number, remit name, remit address, line-item description, quantities, unit prices.
- Preferred payment: ACH (we will provide bank details after enrollment).
- Standard terms: Net30 (we can discuss early-pay options).

Im ccing Logan from vendor ops to support the enrollment and finance for any payment exceptions. If youd like a short 20-min walk-through of the portal we can schedule one today or tomorrow.

Best,
Irene Choi
Vendor Partnerships, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: New vendor registration — remit details & PO flow

Hi Ellen,

Adding a couple of finance-specific items so your team can prepare files correctly and avoid manual holds: 

- Please use the remit name exactly as: Redwood Inference LLC (no punctuation differences). Our AP system normalizes on that string for auto-apply.
- Invoice matching: include PO number in the invoice header and all invoices should show the invoice total as a numeric value (no commas in the total field when uploading via CSV/XML). Line-level detail is preferred for goods; for services total+PO is sufficient.
- Tax: since this is a U.S. supplier, W-9 is sufficient. If you plan to invoice from an EU entity, please attach VAT registration docs and we will flip the VAT flag in our vendor record.
- Payment terms: Net30. We can set up a 2% 10 Net30 early-pay program if youd like to opt in — let me know.

Ive attached a small remit template (vendor_remit_template.xlsx) that shows the exact remit name + sample address format we ingest.

Next operational step: once you confirm the enrollment packet is complete, well provision the vendor record and issue a test PO (we aim to do this within 24 business hours of completed packet).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
